notes.title: 「Ring The Goose」 is here!
notes.notes: [h1]Why is it「Ring The Goose」？[/h1][p]To be honest, this idea came about completely by chance. While I was wandering around the night market brainstorming for a new project, I suddenly came across a stall for "Loop the Goose." The mix of tension, excitement, and that "so close to winning" heartbeat instantly brought back childhood memories. So, I decided to take advantage of the holiday and turn this idea into a real game![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45697115/4f0cc8e431957597d64f829de88bab75c6ef6af3.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]What did I do？[/h1][p]In 「Ring the Goose」, you'll experience diverse maps with different styles, various types of rings, adorable geese and special animals, plus an addictive reward system that keeps you coming back for more! 🔥[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45697115/768a2d0e14b1f772f977076c948468e16a6cfdb5.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]What story will unfold when a ring-toss master is here?[/h1][p]Aim 🎯 > Toss the rings 🪐 > Collect coins 💰 > Unlock surprise rewards 🎁 > Gain powerful buffs ⚡ > Challenge new maps 🗺️ > Collect rare outfits 👗 > Win all the trophies 🏆[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45697115/53c3e82b180a08e6c664557e2b0a356086c61579.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Add it to your wishlist now！ [/h1][p]Want to test your ring-toss skills? Add 「Ring the Goose」 to your wishlist today and don’t miss out![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45697115/2bcc85459748f2f9f05c874acbb76dfd9028939f.png"][/img][/p]
